shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n'
git status --short --branch
printf '\\n--- recent files ---\\n'
rg --files | sed -n '1,160p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/types/messages.ts
printf '\\n--- validation ---\\n'; sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
printf '\\n--- handler ---\\n'; sed -n '1,360p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
printf '\\n--- server refs ---\\n'; rg -n \"createMessageHandler|resume|history|list_sessions|list_conversations|SessionStore\" src/transport src/config.ts src/types src/index.ts | sed -n '1,260p'
printf '\\n--- acceptance ---\\n'; sed -n '1,360p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
printf '\\n--- protocol spec ---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|validated by|spec:\" src specs .lore scripts | sed -n '1,220p'
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '1,120p' src/types/sessionStore.ts
sed -n '1,140p' src/types/index.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx jest --runInBand src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts -t "accepts list_sessions cursors and rejects malformed pagination fields"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts -t "accepts list_sessions cursors and rejects malformed pagination fields"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,150p' src/index.ts
sed -n '1,120p' src/types/session.ts | tail -50
sed -n '1,110p' src/types/messages.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts -t "accepts list_sessions cursors and rejects malformed pagination fields"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts src/types/index.ts src/index.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts -t "accepts list_sessions cursors and rejects malformed pagination fields"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts src/types/index.ts src/index.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/types/index.ts src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
git commit -m "Validate list_sessions pagination frames"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
